mapper.select: SELECT ce.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", ce.schedule_id AS "scheduleId", ce.project_id AS "projectId", ce.workspace_member_id AS "workspaceMemberId", ce.title, ce.content, TO_CHAR(ce.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "startAt", TO_CHAR(ce.end_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "endAt" FROM calendar_events ce JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = ce.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = ce.workspace_id WHERE ce.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.left IS NULL AND ce.schedule_type = 'PERSONAL' AND ce.project_id IS NULL AND ce.task_id IS NULL AND ce.sub_task_id IS NULL ORDER BY ce.start_at ASC, ce.schedule_id ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CALENDAR_EVENTS.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO calendar_events (schedule_id, schedule_type, workspace_id, workspace_member_id, project_id, task_id, sub_task_id, title, content, start_at, end_at, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{scheduleId}, 'PERSONAL', workspace_id, workspace_member_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{startAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), SYSDATE, SYSDATE FROM workspace_members WHERE workspace_member_id = #{workspaceMemberId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 0 AND left IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE calendar_events ce SET title = #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, content = #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, start_at = TO_DATE(#{startAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), end_at = TO_DATE(#{endAt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE ce.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND ce.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ce.workspace_member_id = #{workspaceMemberId} AND ce.schedule_type = 'PERSONAL' AND ce.project_id IS NULL AND ce.task_id IS NULL AND ce.sub_task_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members wm WHERE wm.workspace_member_id = ce.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = ce.workspace_id AND wm.status = 0 AND wm."LEFT" IS NULL )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM calendar_events ce WHERE ce.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND ce.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ce.workspace_member_id = #{workspaceMemberId} AND ce.schedule_type = 'PERSONAL' AND ce.project_id IS NULL AND ce.task_id IS NULL AND ce.sub_task_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members wm WHERE wm.workspace_member_id = ce.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = ce.workspace_id AND wm.status = 0 AND wm."LEFT" IS NULL )
